name: Class 546 Cruiser
description: The Arquitens-class 546, also known as the Class 546 Cruiser, was a modified model of Arquitens-class command cruiser primarily designed for greater speed under the Class 546 program. A Class 546 Cruiser was used by an Imperial remnant led by Moff Gideon. Although similar to the command cruiser model, the Class 546 housed a large internal hangar bay that could be accessed by port and starboard hangar doors and a launch tube at the center of the vessel, along the spine of the vessel Designated as a Lightspeed Cruiser, its bridge was also different from the standard Arquitens-class models, and was equipped with three primary and four secondary sublight engines.

data.name: Class 546 Cruiser
data.armament: Dorsal and ventral quad turbolaser turrets (4)
complement: At least 8 TIE/ln space superiority starfighters
